items.caption: This seal-script-style rendering shows 忘 in the tradition analyzed as 心 “heart” plus 亡, which also serves as the sound component.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style drawing of 忘 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the received 心-and-亡 analysis in a later script style; the rendering is a modern redraw, not an image of an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: This rendering does not establish the graph’s earliest form or date. No securely dated oracle-bone example was verified, and the listed bronze examples are not shown here.
